description: List the organisations publishing on opendata.swiss (federal offices, cantons, cities, companies) or on the City of Zürich portal (departments), with their slug and dataset count. Use the slug as 'publisher' in search_datasets. Examples: {} (largest publishers first), {query: 'statistik'}, {query: 'Kanton Zürich', lang: 'de'}, {portal: 'stadt-zuerich'}.

lang.description: Language for titles/descriptions: de, fr, it or en (default en; falls back to de)

portal.description: Catalogue: 'opendata.swiss' (default, national), 'stadt-zuerich' (City of Zürich, data.stadt-zuerich.ch) or 'envidat' (WSL/ETH environmental research data: snow, glaciers, forests, biodiversity, climate)

query.description: Filter by name/title substring (any language), e.g. 'BFS', 'Bern', 'meteo'

name: list_data_publishers
title: List open-data publishers
